paper.title: Biasing Conformational Sampling in AlphaFold 3 and Boltz-2 via Pair Representation Scaling

generators.name: fixed sequence inference sweep
generators.description: Hold the target amino-acid sequence fixed and draw independent Boltz-2 predictions by varying inference-time MSA subsampling and stochastic seeds.

evidence.quote: Predict the second conformational state of a two-state protein by sweeping an inference-time control over repeated predictions of one fixed sequence, then scoring every draw against both experimental reference structures.

constraints.name: structure pLDDT filter
constraints.description: Require Boltz-2 confidence on each sweep draw before comparing to reference states.

constraints.name: dominant state RMSD
constraints.description: Score each predicted structure against the deposited dominant (inward-facing) reference conformation.

evidence.quote: Metrics: per-state success at 2 Å, worst-case minimum RMSD, fill ratio between states.

constraints.name: alternative state RMSD
constraints.description: Score each predicted structure against the deposited alternative (outward-facing) reference conformation.

evidence.quote: Sai fusion target: boltz2-prediction, called once per sweep draw on an unchanging sequence.

constraints.name: protein length range
constraints.description: Keep the sequence length fixed to the benchmark transporter.

optimizers.name: rejection sampling ensemble filter
optimizers.description: Draw independent Boltz-2 sweep samples and retain the subset whose ensemble best covers both experimental states.

evidence.quote: Topology: propose_score_select — enumerate sweep draws, predict, score against both reference states, keep the ensemble.

model_dependencies.name: Boltz-2
model_dependencies.purpose: Structure prediction for each inference sweep draw on a fixed sequence

evidence.quote: Tier 1 (no fork, do this first): sweep only exposed knobs — seed, diffusion samples, recycles, and MSA subsampling depth.

model_dependencies.name: IOMemP benchmark
model_dependencies.provider: Xie & Huang, J. Chem. Inf. Model. 2024
model_dependencies.purpose: Ground-truth inward- and outward-facing reference structures for validation

evidence.quote: IOMemP: 32 high-resolution inward- and outward-facing structures across 16 transporters, with construction code at https://github.com/JingHuangLab/IOMemP.

steps.operation: Enumerate inference sweep draw (MSA subsample + seed)
Boltz-2 structure prediction for fixed sequence
RMSD to dominant and alternative deposited conformations
Keep top draws whose ensemble covers both reference states

selection_thresholds.name: per-state success at 2 Å
selection_thresholds.applies_to: each sweep draw vs each deposited reference state

evidence.quote: Published baselines to beat or match: default inference recovers 0.61 of reference states per state in AlphaFold 3 versus 0.73 under the swept control

assumptions: Full tier uses E. coli XylE (P0AEJ8) inward 4GBY and outward 4GBZ from the IOMemP transporter benchmark.
Smoke tier substitutes adenylate kinase 4AKE/1AKE (214 aa domain motion) for fast GPU sanity checks.
Tier-1 sweep varies Boltz-2 subsample_msa and max_msa_seqs; pair-representation scaling (β) is recorded as unknown until proto-tools exposes it.
Each constraint may invoke Boltz-2 independently unless Sai fuses or caches shared trunk outputs.
Rejection sampling with num_samples=55 (full) / 6 (smoke) stands in for the paper's 250-model-per-target budget.
unknowns: Pair representation scaling at the Pairformer input is not exposed by boltz2-prediction; Tier 2 requires eject-standalone backend patching.
Ensemble-level per-state success and fill ratio are evaluated offline against IOMemP; the Proto program scores individual draws only.
AF-depth recovered both IOMemP states for 7/16 transporters at 255 models; this fixture targets XylE only in v1.
